context: Headline implementation: collectors must preserve null-skip and duplicate-key behavior; naive toMap/groupingBy can throw or change semantics.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Creates PriceIndex.java with requested methods, record, imports, and Java 17-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves null and duplicate behavior
checklist.description: Skips null categories, accepts duplicate categories, keeps cheapest products, and preserves encounter order of names in grouped lists.

checklist.name: Filters null categories before collectors
checklist.description: Filters product.category() != null before toMap or groupingBy so the refactor preserves the original null-category skip behavior and avoids groupingBy null classifier failures.

checklist.name: Uses explicit merge for cheapest product
checklist.description: Uses Collectors.toMap with a merge function such as BinaryOperator.minBy(Comparator.comparing(Product::price)), or an equivalent grouping/min collector, so duplicate categories cannot throw.

checklist.name: Uses groupingBy with mapping for names
checklist.description: Uses groupingBy(Product::category, mapping(Product::name, toList())) or equivalent collector-based grouping without manual computeIfAbsent.

checklist.name: Keeps implementation readable
checklist.description: Keeps helpers small if used and avoids unrelated abstractions.
